addressing.physical: P001 through P120, engraved order without repeat expansion; include all anacruses and terminal partials.
addressing.staff: Global IDs 1 and 2, the upper and lower staves of player piano, canonical part P1.
addressing.onset: Rational quarters from the beginning of each physical region, separately for every staff/voice.
addressing.capacity: Each staff/voice frame has the region capacity; simultaneous chord members do not add durations.
addressing.coordinates: All boxes and barlines use frozen full-page pixels.
addressing.system_breaks: Every system ends at an engraved barline. No split regions or unmeasured cadenzas.
addressing.fingerings: Retain any printed fingering at its note/chord member address; no new fingering inferred.

staff_voice_capacity_rule: Every extant voice on canonical staff 1 or 2 has the corresponding measure_capacities_q frame. Shorter independent voices do not cause invented rests.
